column1: OrangeHRM Authentication & Post-Login Access Control TestData
PURPOSE
This TestData.xlsx drives QAAI autonomous validation of OrangeHRM login functionality, role-based access control, and session management.
CRITICAL: This is SINGLE-MODULE testing. Focus is ONLY on Authentication — not PIM, Admin, Leave, etc.
SHEET GUIDE
AuthProfiles → Login credentials for Admin and ESS roles; expected dashboard landing pages
FormValidation → Form field validation test data (empty fields, oversized input, etc.)
NegativeAuth → Invalid login scenarios (wrong password, non-existent user, brute force)
SecurityAuth → Security test cases (SQL injection, XSS, command injection, password masking)
RoleAccessControl → Post-login RBAC assertions (which menu items visible for which role)
ExpectedResults → What QAAI must assert per test case (URL, error message, visible element)
README → This sheet; instructions and setup guide
SETUP PREREQUISITES
1. Target URL: https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
2. Admin credentials: Admin / admin123 (fixed, shown on login page)
3. ESS user MUST be created BEFORE running ESS tests:
- Login as Admin
- Navigate to Admin > User Management > Add User
- Create user: username=ess_user_01, role=ESS, password=TestUser@123
4. No CAPTCHA or bot protection on this demo
TEST EXECUTION ORDER
1. AuthProfiles tests: TC-AUTH-01, TC-AUTH-02 (positive login flows first)
2. FormValidation tests: TC-FORM-01 through TC-FORM-09 (form validations)
3. NegativeAuth tests: TC-NEG-01 through TC-NEG-09 (invalid logins)
4. SecurityAuth tests: TC-SEC-01 through TC-SEC-12 (SQL injection, XSS, etc.)
5. RoleAccessControl tests: TC-RBAC-01 through TC-RBAC-04 (RBAC assertions post-login)
6. Logout tests: TC-AUTH-03, TC-AUTH-04 (session cleanup)
KEY ASSUMPTIONS
• Passwords in AuthProfiles are marked SENSITIVE and should NOT be committed to public repos
• Test data is NOT encrypted in this Excel file — handle appropriately
• ESS user creation is a prerequisite manual step before running ESS test cases
• Session timeout is >30 mins so tests don't time out mid-execution
COVERAGE SUMMARY
• 4 valid login scenarios (Admin + ESS × login + logout)
• 9 form validation test cases
• 9 negative login scenarios (invalid creds, brute force)
• 12 security test cases (SQL injection, XSS, password masking, etc.)
• 4 RBAC test cases (role-specific menu visibility)
• 11 expected result assertions
Total: ~40+ test cases for comprehensive Authentication validation
